verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents built-in support for 'cutting-edge model-native agents' from Claude, OpenAI, Gemini and Grok alongside open-source frameworks. This implies a computer-use style agent mode as an alternative to the DOM/Playwright-based HyperAgent path, but the evidence never states that these agents act on screenshots. Screenshot output from the scrape and fetch APIs is a data format, not an action mode, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the agents operate on screenshots or coordinates, a way to switch between DOM and vision modes, evidence of handling canvases or non-DOM UIs, and hands-on corroboration.
